title: evomedia.net in ninety seconds
goal: Show what the site is and where the proof lives - the projects, the fleet's public test and coverage boards, and the writing.
audience: Someone deciding in two minutes whether to read further.

steps.narration: This is evomedia dot net, Kelly Michels' portfolio. Everything on it is built, deployed and measured by the person whose name is on it.
The front page is a summary. The real content is one click deeper, so the header stays pinned wherever you scroll.
The projects page lists every product in the fleet, each with a stage label. Alpha and beta mean exactly what they say.
evo dot e h s is the largest of them: a multi-tenant permit-to-work system for industrial sites, with an Ask A I assistant grounded in each site's own data.
This board is the fleet's test results, every suite, every day, published from the same run that produced them. All green means all green today.
And the tooling that runs all of it is public too: the deploy, backup and release scripts, with their own tests and changelog.
That is the tour. This video was recorded, narrated and captioned by an agent, using evo dot videostroll.
